mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_id, team_code, role_code, is_leader, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, delete_flag FROM team_employees WHERE team_code = #{teamCode} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}

SELECT id, employee_id, team_code, role_code, is_leader, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, delete_flag FROM team_employees WHERE team_code = #{teamCode} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@DELETED.value}

SELECT e.id, e.client_id, e.user_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.system_role, e.image_url, e.salary, e.created_at, e.updated_at, e.deleted_at, e.delete_flag FROM employees e INNER JOIN team_employees te ON e.client_id = te.employee_id WHERE te.team_code = #{teamCode} AND te.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} AND e.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}

SELECT e.id, e.client_id, e.user_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.system_role, e.image_url, e.salary, e.created_at, e.updated_at, e.deleted_at, e.delete_flag FROM employees e INNER JOIN team_employees te ON e.client_id = te.employee_id WHERE te.team_code = #{teamCode} AND te.is_leader = true AND te.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} AND e.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_employees (employee_id, team_code, role_code, is_leader, created_at, updated_at, delete_flag) VALUES (#{teamEmployee.employeeId}, #{teamEmployee.teamCode}, #{teamEmployee.roleCode}, #{teamEmployee.isLeader}, #{teamEmployee.createdAt}, #{teamEmployee.updatedAt}, #{teamEmployee.deleteFlag})
